best_for: People and families moving off browser-saved passwords who want a free vault on every device, and who may pay about USD 20 a year for extras.

points.title: The free plan is not a trial
points.text: Free covers unlimited passwords on unlimited devices, the desktop, browser and mobile apps, the password generator, Bitwarden Send and encrypted export. Sharing is limited to one other person.

points.title: What Premium adds
points.text: Premium is listed at USD 1.65 per month, billed yearly as USD 19.80. It adds a built-in authenticator for two-factor codes, 5 GB of file attachments, emergency access and vault health reports. Families is USD 3.99 per month billed yearly (USD 47.88) for up to 6 premium users with unlimited sharing. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Teams and companies pay per seat
points.text: Teams is listed at USD 4 per user per month and Enterprise at USD 6, both billed yearly. Enterprise adds SSO, policies and self-hosting.

points.title: Code you can inspect
points.text: The code is public on GitHub under AGPL 3.0 and the Bitwarden License, the vault is end-to-end encrypted, and Bitwarden publishes yearly third-party audits plus SOC 2 and ISO 27001 reports.

points.title: Open the vault with a fingerprint or face
points.text: The desktop app can open your vault with Windows Hello on Windows, Touch ID on a Mac, or system authentication on Linux. On Linux that needs a polkit agent and a secret service such as GNOME Keyring.

points.title: Pick the right Windows build
points.text: Builds exist for x86, x64 and Arm64, as a per-user or machine-wide installer, a portable app and a Store package. The portable app does not update itself. The Windows listing keeps 97 versions; macOS and Linux list only the current release, so downgrades there need another source.

points.title: Linux here is Flatpak
points.text: The Linux build listed here is the Flathub package, which Flathub marks as verified for Bitwarden Inc. Bitwarden's own help also documents AppImage, .deb, .rpm and Snap installs.
